rationale: Reporter gives a full pyproject, commands, outputs and uv version. `uv lock` honors required-environments (fails as documented) while `uv pip compile --universal` silently ignores it, though it honors `environments`. Docs describe required-environments as a general resolution setting; a maintainer could alternatively say it is not supported in the pip interface (enhancement/docs). Searches found no prior issue on this; I did not read the settings docs page in detail.
